feed.title: Artificial Intelligence Benefits Database: feed of new and revised records

entry.title: TA Pounce chatbot helps Georgia State students earn higher grades
entry.summary: In trials with 2,483 Georgia State students in online Government and Microeconomics courses from 2021 to 2023, the TA Pounce text chatbot raised the share earning an A or B by 4 points.

entry.title: Virginia tested AI to help agencies review regulations
entry.summary: Virginia piloted Vulcan Justinian to analyze state regulations in 2025 and ended the pilot in 2026; no source establishes how much the AI contributed to claimed savings.

entry.title: StratLoom offers AI-assisted curriculum work to educators and learners
entry.summary: StratLoom describes AI-assisted curriculum work and supervised prompt practice in its Digital Roots programs; it publishes no evidence that learning or educator efficiency improved.

entry.title: Software flags a nurse’s brain bleed, and she returns to full-time work
entry.summary: Software, apparently Viz.ai, detected Julie Knichel’s brain bleed and alerted her doctors; after treatment, she returned to full-time nursing.

entry.title: AI summaries of planning consultations save council officers time
entry.summary: West Oxfordshire and Cotswold councils report that AI tagging and summaries in Konveio and Go Vocal cut planning officers' repetitive administrative time by an estimated 85%.

entry.title: Tunbridge Wells museum uses AI editing to process artifact scans faster
entry.summary: Tunbridge Wells Borough Council reports that AI masking and editing in Adobe Lightroom made The Amelia Scott museum's scan and image processing 50% faster.

entry.title: A chatbot cuts calls and improves routing in South Cambridgeshire
entry.summary: South Cambridgeshire District Council reports that its EBI.AI chatbot cut calls and improved routing; councillors later said that some callers hung up without help.

entry.title: Halton's family-hub app gives families information at any hour
entry.summary: Halton Borough Council reports that its Beebot AI family-hub platform offers information at any hour and that its automation has begun to reduce staff administrative work.

entry.title: Copilot saves Buckinghamshire staff time and helps a deaf colleague
entry.summary: Buckinghamshire Council reports that Microsoft Copilot cut call wrap-up by an average of two minutes a call and helped a deaf colleague take part in meetings more independently.

entry.title: Culturalink connects cultural knowledge across countries
entry.summary: Culturalink organizes heritage information and generates cultural narratives, and it uses the DeepSeek language model to link heritages; no source measures a learning or preservation result.

entry.title: Participants in the UN Women AI School build custom GPTs for advocacy
entry.summary: UN Women’s AI School has participants use ChatGPT, Gemini and Microsoft Copilot and build custom GPTs for research and advocacy; no source measures what the AI changed.

entry.title: A research project proposes AI to flag risky clauses in user agreements
entry.summary: A Zambian final-year research project proposes an unnamed AI model that would summarize terms of service and privacy policies and flag clauses that could compromise users' rights.

entry.title: AI colonoscopy flags a polyp; stage I cancer removed in Chiayi
entry.summary: After a positive fecal occult blood test, Fujifilm AI endoscopy at St. Martin De Porres Hospital, Chiayi, marked a 1 to 1.5 cm adenoma; pathology: stage I colorectal cancer, removed endoscopically.

entry.title: Whale Safe grades ship cooperation with 10-knot slowdowns
entry.summary: Whale Safe rates whale presence from acoustic buoys, sightings and a habitat model and grades ship cooperation with California's voluntary 10-knot zones; no avoided strike is documented.

entry.title: AIMS's ReefScan and ReefCloud automate reef image analysis
entry.summary: Authors including AIMS staff report that ReefScan surveys made island-scale reef assessments possible; an independent team found that ReefCloud's model annotations agreed poorly with a researcher's.

entry.title: AI cameras alert Kenyan rangers to intruders at three rhino sites
entry.summary: The Kenya Wildlife Service installed FLIR thermal cameras whose built-in AI alerts rangers to intruders at three black rhino sites; no arrest or prevented poaching is linked to them.

entry.title: Android Earthquake Alerts warns over 16 million users of an earthquake
entry.summary: Google's Android Earthquake Alerts detected the Marmara Ereğlisi earthquake of 23 April 2025 and alerted over 16 million users, but its stronger alert missed inland areas of moderate shaking.

entry.title: Turkmenistan fixes eight methane leaks after UN satellite alerts
entry.summary: UNEP lists eight methane leaks in Turkmenistan that were mitigated from November 2024 to March 2026 after alerts from its Methane Alert and Response System (MARS), which uses AI.

entry.title: Operator fixes an Alberta methane leak a week after a satellite alert
entry.summary: The Methane Alert and Response System of the United Nations Environment Programme detected a leak in Alberta on 10 April 2026, and the operator repaired it on 17 April 2026.

entry.title: Kazakh operator stops a methane leak after a UN alert; emissions recur
entry.summary: After an alert from UNEP's Methane Alert and Response System, which uses AI, an operator in Kazakhstan rerouted gas to stop a pipeline leak; UNEP observed new emissions at the site by 21 May 2026.

entry.title: Colombia's Constitutional Court adopts PretorIA to sort tutela rulings
entry.summary: Colombia's Constitutional Court presented PretorIA on 27 July 2020 to classify and search tutela rulings for selection, and the court still used it in 2024; no source measures an outcome.

entry.title: Apple Watch shows a woman's heart rate falling as her arrhythmia ends
entry.summary: An 80-year-old woman's Apple Watch Series 3 showed a sudden drop in heart rate from 99 to 65 beats per minute at 19:29, when a Holter monitor recorded her reversion to sinus rhythm.

entry.title: GNoME predicts 2.2 million crystals, and critics find duplicates
entry.summary: DeepMind's GNoME graph networks proposed 2.2 million crystal structures (380,000 stable); independent researchers found duplicates and scant evidence of useful new compounds.

entry.title: Microsoft Copilot tutoring raises test scores in Benin City schools
entry.summary: In a World Bank randomized trial in Benin City, six weeks of teacher-guided Microsoft Copilot (GPT-4) tutoring raised scores 0.31 standard deviations overall and 0.23 in English.

entry.title: IMIE intelligent retina restores partial vision to a blind woman
entry.summary: After Xiangya Hospital implanted the IMIE intelligent retina, a 61-year-old woman blind for over ten years could identify E optotypes and walk indoors without an escort.

entry.title: Locust control fed by eLocust3m may have averted USD 1.56 billion
entry.summary: PlantVillage's eLocust3m app gathered over 240,000 locust records, and AI removed unusable ones for the control operation that FAO credits with averting USD 1.56 billion in losses.

entry.title: Data mining grows to half of French tax controls, with efficiency gains
entry.summary: The Cour des comptes found that data mining, including machine learning in the French tax administration's CFVR program, came to originate half of tax controls and made choosing them more efficient.

entry.title: SES Water's AI leak alarms cut leak run times by up to 40%
entry.summary: SES Water's Aquasuite Burst compares data from 1,000 flow and pressure sensors with predicted levels and raises leak alarms within minutes; the utility reports that run times fell by up to 40%.

entry.title: Flint uses a prediction model to find homes with hazardous water pipes
entry.summary: ActiveRemediation, a model built at the University of Michigan, ranked Flint homes for inspection and replacement of lead or galvanized-steel service lines, with 91.6% held-out accuracy.

entry.title: Owner designs dog's cancer vaccine with AI; tumor halves before relapse
entry.summary: Paul Conyngham used ChatGPT and AlphaFold to choose targets for an mRNA vaccine; with a checkpoint inhibitor, it halved Rosie's largest tumor by early 2026 before the cancer returned.

entry.title: DeepMind's AI helps US forecasters predict Hurricane Melissa early
entry.summary: The US National Hurricane Center blended Google DeepMind's AI ensemble into its Melissa forecasts from 21 October 2025; the center's track errors at 120 hours were less than half its five-year mean.

entry.title: After a RapidAI stroke alert, doctors reopen a firefighter's artery fast
entry.summary: RapidAI's large vessel occlusion alert prompted a physician to mobilize the stroke team for Eric, 29; thrombectomy restored flow under 60 minutes from arrival; no deficits.

entry.title: Two amputees regain daily activities with Coapt-controlled prostheses
entry.summary: Two transulnar amputees given Coapt pattern-recognition prostheses on osseointegration implants regained activities of daily living.

entry.title: Drug found with a knowledge graph lowered COVID-19 deaths in a trial
entry.summary: BenevolentAI researchers used the Benevolent Platform's knowledge graph to identify baricitinib for COVID-19, and in the RECOVERY trial mortality was 12% with the drug and 14% with usual care alone.

entry.title: A demand-routing app helps less skilled taxi drivers find fares
entry.summary: In Yokohama in December 2019, the AI Navi app cut taxi drivers' cruising time by 5% on average and 7% for low-skilled drivers, narrowing the skill gap by 13.4%.

entry.title: A GPT-4 tool helps lone P&G staff match human teams
entry.summary: In a field experiment with 776 P&G professionals, individuals using a GPT-4-based tool raised solution quality by 0.37 SD and spent 16.4% less time, matching teams without AI.

entry.title: Machine translation lifts cross-border sales on eBay
entry.summary: eBay's in-house machine translation, introduced for Latin America in May 2014, raised exports on eBay by 10.9% in the published study and 17.5% to 20.9% in the working paper.

entry.title: ChatGPT saves science teachers planning time each week
entry.summary: In an NFER trial in 68 schools, teachers using ChatGPT with a guide spent 56.2 minutes a week on Year 7 and 8 science lesson preparation against 81.5 minutes for teachers without it.

entry.title: Two legal AI tools improve students' legal work in a trial
entry.summary: In a randomized trial with 137 law students, Vincent AI and o1-preview raised the quality of legal work and raised productivity on five of six tasks by 50% to 130%.

entry.title: GPT-4 speeds up legal drafting for law students
entry.summary: In a randomized trial with 60 Minnesota law students, GPT-4 cut time on four legal tasks by 11.8% to 32.1%, with slight and uneven gains in quality.

entry.title: ChatGPT speeds up everyday professional writing
entry.summary: In a preregistered experiment with 453 college-educated professionals, ChatGPT cut time on writing tasks by 40% and raised graded quality by 18%.

entry.title: Consultants with GPT-4 finish more tasks in less time
entry.summary: In a preregistered experiment with 758 BCG consultants, GPT-4 users completed 12.2% more tasks 25.1% faster with higher quality, but erred more on a task beyond its reach.

entry.title: A chat assistant helps new support agents resolve more issues
entry.summary: A GPT-based chat assistant raised issues resolved per hour by 15% on average among 5,172 support agents, with the largest gains for novice and low-skilled agents.

entry.title: Camera-trap software helps an island program hunt feral cats
entry.summary: On Kangaroo Island, eVorta AI found 97.9% of 492 feral cat images against 95.3% for staff; with 4G cameras, the board estimates A$2.15 million saved over three years.

entry.title: A sound recognizer nearly matches bird experts on a Munich rooftop
entry.summary: TU Munich researchers compared BirdNET with two experts on 15.5 hours of rooftop recordings; with tuned settings BirdNET reached an F1 score of 0.84 and found one species the experts missed.

entry.title: A computer screen finds antibody fragments for an itch receptor
entry.summary: Harvard and UCSF researchers co-folded 10,000 nanobodies with MRGPRX2 in AlphaFold-Multimer; of ten tested, three bound at 20 to 200 nM and blocked mast cell degranulation.

entry.title: A predicted model unlocks a stubborn crystal structure
entry.summary: After two years of failed phasing, a CNRS team in Palaiseau solved the structure of a protein from the mRNA decay pathway by molecular replacement with AlphaFold and RoseTTAFold models.

entry.title: A predicted receptor shape speeds the search for psychiatric drug leads
entry.summary: Uppsala and Karolinska researchers docked compounds against AlphaFold models of TAAR1; 18 of 30 tested were agonists (60%), against 22% from a homology model.

entry.title: Predicted protein shapes guide a search for new drug leads
entry.summary: UCSF-led teams docked up to 1.6 billion molecules against AlphaFold2 models of the sigma-2 and 5-HT2A receptors; hit rates (54% and 26%) matched those from experimental structures.

entry.title: Europe's forecast center tests Pangu-Weather beside its own model
entry.summary: ECMWF ran Huawei's Pangu-Weather from its own analyses and found accuracy comparable to its IFS model, with better summer temperature-event forecasts in Europe.

entry.title: NICE lets NHS talking therapies use the Limbic Access chatbot
entry.summary: NICE cites a study in which NHS services using the Limbic Access referral chatbot saw referrals rise 15% against 6% in control services, with larger rises in minority groups.

entry.title: NICE backs AI help for spotting fractures on X-rays
entry.summary: NICE reviewed 16 studies of AI fracture software such as BoneView and found that readers' sensitivity rose without lost specificity, from 61% to 74% in one study.

entry.title: NICE finds AI outlining quicker for radiotherapy planning
entry.summary: NICE reviewed 79 studies and concluded that AI autocontouring with clinician review, by systems such as MVision and Limbus Contour, is likely equivalent to manual contouring and quicker.

entry.title: England's health technology assessor backs AI help in colonoscopy
entry.summary: NICE reviewed 70 studies, most of them randomized trials, and concluded that AI polyp detection systems such as GI Genius improve the adenoma detection rate in colonoscopy.

entry.title: Europe's medicines regulator accepts AIM-NASH for biopsy scoring
entry.summary: EMA qualified PathAI's AIM-NASH after a 1,481-case validation in which AI-assisted pathologists agreed better with expert panels on inflammation and ballooning.

entry.title: Medicare's payment review credits ContaCT with faster stroke alerts
entry.summary: CMS found that Viz.ai ContaCT shortens time to specialist notification for large vessel occlusion stroke; in routine use the median time to notification was 4.31 minutes.

entry.title: Auditors review the Justice Transcribe note tool in probation
entry.summary: The NAO reports that Justice Transcribe, an AI note tool, summarized over 1,600,000 probation meetings in England and Wales, an estimated 266,667 hours saved.

entry.title: Model Dermatology helps trainees diagnose skin lesions in Seoul
entry.summary: In a Seoul trial of 576 patients with suspicious skin lesions, non-expert physicians using Model Dermatology diagnosed 53.9% correctly against 43.8% without it.

entry.title: Cybersight AI results on the day lift eye referrals in Kigali
entry.summary: In the RAIDERS trial at four Kigali diabetes clinics, immediate Cybersight AI feedback raised 30-day referral attendance to 51.5% from 39.6% with delayed human grading.

entry.title: SELENA+ results on the spot bring more Tanzanians to eye care
entry.summary: In a Tanzanian trial of 2,378 people with diabetes, SELENA+ results and counselling at screening raised clinic attendance for referable retinopathy from 18.2% to 35.9%.
